title: Topological triviality of μ-constant surface singularities

result.label: Topological triviality of μ-constant surface singularities
result.statement: Proves topological right-triviality for every holomorphic one-parameter family of isolated hypersurface singularities in ℂ 3 with constant Milnor number, resolving the surface case of the μ -constant problem. After shrinking the parameter disk and representatives, ambient homeomorphisms vary jointly continuously, fix the origin section and preserve the defining functions.
